name: Hushed Bank
summary: Along Duskwood’s western river, Hushed Bank runs from Three Corners toward Stranglethorn Vale. Beasts prowl its quiet shore, where dark mysteries linger.

sections.title: A Frontier Along the River
sections.body: At Hushed Bank, Duskwood’s western edge follows the river that divides the forest from Westfall. The covered wooden bridge carries travelers west out of the grim wood. Near it, the land shifts from open plains and sunlit farms into unnatural twilight. Thick underbrush and creeping fog crowd the riverbanks. Large spiders and hungry forest wolves stalk wayfarers who stray from the path.

sections.title: Outcasts and Hermits
sections.body: Near the north end of Hushed Bank, Sven Yorgen and his companion Lars keep camp in the dense woods, away from Darkshire’s suspicious eyes. They watch the treeline and harbor bitter grievances tied to the region’s dark tragedies. Their isolated refuge is one of the few signs of living humanoids along this lonely shore.

faq.q: Where is the Hushed Bank located?
faq.answer: Hushed Bank runs along Duskwood’s western edge, beside the river separating the forest from Westfall. It stretches from the fork near Three Corners south toward the borders leading to Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What connects the Hushed Bank to Westfall?
aliases: how to cross river to westfall
faq.answer: A covered wooden bridge spans the river at Hushed Bank, letting travelers and carts cross between Westfall’s sunny plains and Duskwood’s cursed gloom.

faq.q: Who lives along the Hushed Bank?
faq.answer: Sven Yorgen and his companion Lars keep camp in the northern part of Hushed Bank. They live as isolated recluses, having fled the horrors that claimed Sven’s nearby farm.

faq.q: What threats are found along this shoreline?
faq.answer: Vicious woodland beasts prowl Hushed Bank, including large webwood spiders and predatory dusking wolves that prey on anything moving through the brush.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can track the wolves and spiders that haunt the dense foliage along the riverbank, classic wilderness beasts of the forest’s darker reaches.
As an Alliance traveler, you can cross the covered bridge that links Westfall’s farmlands to Duskwood’s besieged outpost.
